Drone attacks target tankers in Strait of Hormuz, raising energy supply concerns

Multiple drone attacks have targeted commercial tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, a critical chokepoint for global energy supplies. The incidents have heightened concerns about the security of oil and gas shipments. British forces have reportedly responded to one of the attacks, while one report attributes a larger operation involving eight tankers to Ukraine.
